pattern: を踏まえて（をふまえて）
purpose: Use known facts or earlier results as the basis for a next step.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
N + を踏まえて / を踏まえた + N
We will decide the policy based on the survey results.
The plan incorporates lessons from last time.
I revised the text taking everyone’s comments into account.
formation: N + を踏まえて / を踏まえた + N
restrictions: Often with 経験, 結果, 意見, and 事実.
mistake: The next action should actually take account of that basis.
